officialSummary: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to The Suri Friends’ Union Co-operative Bank Ltd., Suri, West Bengal vide Directive No. CO.DOS.SED.No.S2574/12-07-005/2022-23 dated July 21, 2022 for a period of six months up to close of business on January 22, 2023, which were last extended up to close of business on October 22, 2026 vide Directive No. DOR.MON.D-25/12.29.046/2026-27 dated July 14, 2026. The Reserve Bank of India is satisfied that in the public interest, it is necessary to further extend the period of operation of the Directive beyond close of business on October 22, 2026. 2. Accordingly, the Reserve Bank of India, in exercise of powers vested in it under sub-section (1) of Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, hereby extends the Directive for a further period of three months from close of business on October 22, 2026 to close of business on January 22, 2027, subject to review. 3. The aforesaid extension and /or modification by the Reserve Bank of India should not per-se be construed to imply that the Reserve Bank of India is satisfied with the financial position of the bank. 4. Other terms and conditions of the Directive under reference, shall remain unchanged. (Brij Raj) Chief General Manager Press Release: 2026-2027/1367
title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – The Suri Friends’ Union Co-operative Bank Ltd., Suri, West Bengal – Extension of period

officialSummary: Government of India has announced the sale (re-issue) of Government Securities, as detailed below, through auction to be held on October 23, 2026 (Friday). As per the extant scheme of underwriting commitment notified on November 14, 2007, the amounts of Minimum Underwriting Commitment (MUC) and the minimum bidding commitment under Additional Competitive Underwriting (ACU) auction, applicable to each Primary Dealer (PD), are as under: (₹ crore) Security Notified Amount MUC amount per PD Minimum bidding commitment per PD under ACU auction 6.53% GS 2031 19,000 453 453 7.71% GS 2066 14,000 334 334 The underwriting auction will be conducted through multiple price-based method on October 23, 2026 (Friday). PDs may submit their bids for ACU auction electronically through Reserve Bank of India’s Core Banking Solution (e-Kuber system) between 09:00 A.M. and 09:30 A.M. on the day of underwriting auction. The underwriting commission will be credited to the current account of the respective PDs with RBI on the day of issue of securities.
